description: Variation of Condition Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 2 (Time ) of planning permission 23/00226/FUL  to remove Condition 2 to enable hours detailed in condition 3 (0900 to 03:00 hrs, Mondays to Sundays) to become permanent.
decision_conditions: The approved development shall be carried out in accordance with the following drawings/details: Cover Letter Noise Assessment Plant Noise Impact Assessment Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The use with the extended hours set out in condition 4 hereby permitted shall be as set out in perpetuity.Reason: In accordance with section 72 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, a temporary period is considered justified to assess the effect of the development on the area and to ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The use hereby permitted shall only take place between the following hours: 0900 - 03:00 hrs, Mondays - Sundays.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the implementation of the extended opening hours set out in Condition 3, all recommendations set out in the submitted Noise Assessment (PR2001_76_FINAL_R4 dated 27/01/2023) shall be implemented in full, notably the repair works identified in Table 1 of the report and the control measures set out in section 5.2 of the report (repeated below for avoidance of doubt) which shall be implemented prior to first use of the development and retained in a reasonable condition thereafter: o Signs are included inside and outside the premises encouraging patrons to respect the neighbours and keep noise levels to a minimum when entering and leaving the site; o Staff encourage those who go outside to smoke to not talk and stay as close to the building as possible; o If any noise generating behaviour is observed then staff are to ask the person to respect the neighbours. If instances continue then the individual should be asked to leave;Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development shall continue to accord with the noise management details submitted and approved under application 23/00856/CLC dated 26/04/2023 following the permanent implementation of the extended opening hours set out in Condition 3 and the noise management measures shall be retained thereafter. Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012. Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to the implementation of the extended opening hours set out in Condition 3, the sound insulation measures implemented through 17/14386/COND shall be repaired in accordance with the recommendations set out in Table 1 of the submitted Noise Assessment (PR2001_76_FINAL_R4 dated 27/01/2023) and shall be retained thereafter. Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The amusement machines installed in the premises shall be restricted to amusement with prize machines only. Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

No games of a sessional nature shall be played on the premises. Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential occupiers in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

A window display shall be provided at all time in the windows fronting High Street. Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of the surrounding area in accordance with Policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.
